verses.original: אַחַ֣ר׀ הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֗לֶּה הָיָ֤ה דְבַר־ יְהוָה֙ אֶל־ אַבְרָ֔ם בַּֽמַּחֲזֶ֖ה לֵאמֹ֑ר אַל־ תִּירָ֣א אַבְרָ֗ם אָנֹכִי֙ מָגֵ֣ן לָ֔ךְ שְׂכָרְךָ֖ הַרְבֵּ֥ה מְאֹֽד׃
verses.transliteration: ’a·ḥar had·də·ḇā·rîm hā·’êl·leh hā·yāh ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh ’el- ’aḇ·rām bam·ma·ḥă·zeh lê·mōr ’al- tî·rā ’aḇ·rām ’ā·nō·ḵî mā·ḡên lāḵ śə·ḵā·rə·ḵā har·bêh mə·’ōḏ
verses.literal: After these events the word of the LORD came to Abram in a vision . . . Do not be afraid Abram I am your shield your very great reward
verses.literalPt: Depois destas coisas, veio a palavra de Jeová a Abrão, numa visão, dizendo: Não temas, Abrão; eu sou teu escudo, a tua recompensa será infinitamente grande.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אַבְרָ֗ם אֲדֹנָ֤י יֱהוִה֙ מַה־ תִּתֶּן־ לִ֔י וְאָנֹכִ֖י הוֹלֵ֣ךְ עֲרִירִ֑י וּבֶן־ מֶ֣שֶׁק בֵּיתִ֔י ה֖וּא דַּמֶּ֥שֶׂק אֱלִיעֶֽזֶר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’aḇ·rām ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh mah- tit·ten- lî wə·’ā·nō·ḵî hō·w·lêḵ ‘ă·rî·rî ū·ḇen- me·šeq bê·ṯî hū dam·me·śeq ’ĕ·lî·‘e·zer
verses.literal: But Abram replied O Lord GOD what can You give me since I remain childless and the heir . . . of my house . . . is Eliezer of Damascus
verses.literalPt: Respondeu Abrão: Senhor Jeová, que me darás, visto que morro sem filhos, e o herdeiro da minha casa é Eliézer de Damasco?

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אַבְרָ֔ם הֵ֣ן לִ֔י לֹ֥א נָתַ֖תָּה זָ֑רַע וְהִנֵּ֥ה בֶן־ בֵּיתִ֖י יוֹרֵ֥שׁ אֹתִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’aḇ·rām hên lî lō nā·ṯat·tāh zā·ra‘ wə·hin·nêh ḇen- bê·ṯî yō·w·rêš ’ō·ṯî
verses.literal: Abram continued Behold You have given me no offspring so a servant in my household will be my heir
verses.literalPt: Acrescentou Abrão: Eis que a mim não me tens dado filhos, e um escravo vai ser o meu herdeiro.

verses.original: וְהִנֵּ֨ה דְבַר־ יְהוָ֤ה אֵלָיו֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר לֹ֥א יִֽירָשְׁךָ֖ זֶ֑ה כִּי־ אִם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יֵצֵ֣א מִמֵּעֶ֔יךָ ה֖וּא יִֽירָשֶֽׁךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hin·nêh ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh ’ê·lāw lê·mōr lō yî·rā·šə·ḵā zeh kî- ’im ’ă·šer yê·ṣê mim·mê·‘e·ḵā hū yî·rā·še·ḵā
verses.literal: Then the word of the LORD came to Abram saying This one will not be your heir but . . . one who comes from your own body will be your heir
verses.literalPt: Veio-lhe a palavra de Jeová: Este não será o teu herdeiro; porém aquele que será gerado de ti será o teu herdeiro.

verses.original: וַיּוֹצֵ֨א אֹת֜וֹ הַח֗וּצָה וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ הַבֶּט־ נָ֣א הַשָּׁמַ֗יְמָה וּסְפֹר֙ הַכּ֣וֹכָבִ֔ים אִם־ תּוּכַ֖ל לִסְפֹּ֣ר אֹתָ֑ם וַיֹּ֣אמֶר ל֔וֹ כֹּ֥ה יִהְיֶ֖ה זַרְעֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·w·ṣê ’ō·ṯōw ha·ḥū·ṣāh way·yō·mer hab·beṭ- nā haš·šā·may·māh ū·sə·p̄ōr hak·kō·w·ḵā·ḇîm ’im- tū·ḵal lis·pōr ’ō·ṯām way·yō·mer lōw kōh yih·yeh zar·‘e·ḵā
verses.literal: And the LORD took him outside and said Now look to the heavens and count the stars if you are able . . . Then He told him So shall your offspring be
verses.literalPt: Fez-lhe sair para fora e disse: Olha para o céu e conta as estrelas, se as poderes contar; e disse-lhe: Assim será a tua semente.

verses.original: וְהֶאֱמִ֖ן בַּֽיהוָ֑ה וַיַּחְשְׁבֶ֥הָ לּ֖וֹ צְדָקָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·he·’ĕ·min Yah·weh way·yaḥ·šə·ḇe·hā lōw ṣə·ḏā·qāh
verses.literal: Abram believed the LORD and it was credited to him as righteousness
verses.literalPt: Creu Abrão em Jeová, que lhe imputou isto como justiça.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֖אמֶר אֵלָ֑יו אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר הוֹצֵאתִ֙יךָ֙ מֵא֣וּר כַּשְׂדִּ֔ים לָ֧תֶת לְךָ֛ אֶת־ הָאָ֥רֶץ הַזֹּ֖את לְרִשְׁתָּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ê·lāw ’ă·nî Yah·weh ’ă·šer hō·w·ṣê·ṯî·ḵā mê·’ūr kaś·dîm lā·ṯeṯ lə·ḵā ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ haz·zōṯ lə·riš·tāh
verses.literal: The LORD also told him I am the LORD who brought you out of Ur of the Chaldeans to give you this land to possess
verses.literalPt: Disse-lhe mais: Eu sou Jeová, que te fiz sair de Ur dos caldeus, a fim de te dar esta terra em herança.

verses.original: וַיֹּאמַ֑ר אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהוִ֔ה בַּמָּ֥ה אֵדַ֖ע כִּ֥י אִֽירָשֶֽׁנָּה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh bam·māh ’ê·ḏa‘ kî ’î·rā·šen·nāh
verses.literal: But Abram replied Lord GOD how can I know that I will possess it
verses.literalPt: Perguntou-lhe Abrão: Ó Senhor Jeová, como saberei que a hei de herdar?

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֗יו קְחָ֥ה לִי֙ עֶגְלָ֣ה מְשֻׁלֶּ֔שֶׁת וְעֵ֥ז מְשֻׁלֶּ֖שֶׁת וְאַ֣יִל מְשֻׁלָּ֑שׁ וְתֹ֖ר וְגוֹזָֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ê·lāw qə·ḥāh lî ‘eḡ·lāh mə·šul·le·šeṯ wə·‘êz mə·šul·le·šeṯ wə·’a·yil mə·šul·lāš wə·ṯōr wə·ḡō·w·zāl
verses.literal: And the LORD said to him Bring Me a heifer a goat and a ram each three years old along with a turtledove and a young pigeon
verses.literalPt: Respondeu-lhe: Toma-me uma novilha de três anos, e uma cabra de três anos, e um carneiro de três anos, e uma rola, e um pombinho.

verses.original: וַיִּֽקַּֽח־ ל֣וֹ אֶת־ כָּל־ אֵ֗לֶּה וַיְבַתֵּ֤ר אֹתָם֙ בַּתָּ֔וֶךְ וַיִּתֵּ֥ן אִישׁ־ בִּתְר֖וֹ לִקְרַ֣את רֵעֵ֑הוּ וְאֶת־ הַצִפֹּ֖ר לֹ֥א בָתָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·qaḥ- lōw ’eṯ- kāl- ’êl·leh way·ḇat·têr ’ō·ṯām bat·tā·weḵ way·yit·tên ’îš- biṯ·rōw liq·raṯ rê·‘ê·hū wə·’eṯ- ha·ṣip·pōr lō ḇā·ṯār
verses.literal: So Abram brought all these to Him split each of them down the middle and laid the halves opposite each other The birds however he did not cut in half
verses.literalPt: Ele, tomando todos esses animais, os partiu pelo meio e pôs cada metade em frente da outra; mas as aves não partiu.

verses.original: וַיֵּ֥רֶד הָעַ֖יִט עַל־ הַפְּגָרִ֑ים וַיַּשֵּׁ֥ב אֹתָ֖ם אַבְרָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·reḏ hā·‘a·yiṭ ‘al- hap·pə·ḡā·rîm way·yaš·šêḇ ’ō·ṯām ’aḇ·rām
verses.literal: And the birds of prey descended on the carcasses but Abram drove them away
verses.literalPt: As aves de rapina desciam sobre os cadáveres, porém Abrão as enxotava.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֤י הַשֶּׁ֙מֶשׁ֙ לָב֔וֹא וְתַרְדֵּמָ֖ה נָפְלָ֣ה עַל־ אַבְרָ֑ם וְהִנֵּ֥ה אֵימָ֛ה חֲשֵׁכָ֥ה גְדֹלָ֖ה נֹפֶ֥לֶת עָלָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî haš·še·meš lā·ḇō·w wə·ṯar·dê·māh nā·p̄ə·lāh ‘al- ’aḇ·rām wə·hin·nêh ’ê·māh ḥă·šê·ḵāh ḡə·ḏō·lāh nō·p̄e·leṯ ‘ā·lāw
verses.literal: As the sun was setting Abram fell into a deep sleep and suddenly great terror and darkness overwhelmed him
verses.literalPt: Quando o sol ia a entrar, caiu um profundo sono sobre Abrão; eis que lhe sobreveio um horror de grandes trevas.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר לְאַבְרָ֗ם יָדֹ֨עַ תֵּדַ֜ע כִּי־ גֵ֣ר׀ יִהְיֶ֣ה זַרְעֲךָ֗ בְּאֶ֙רֶץ֙ לֹ֣א לָהֶ֔ם וַעֲבָד֖וּם וְעִנּ֣וּ אֹתָ֑ם אַרְבַּ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer lə·’aḇ·rām yā·ḏō·a‘ tê·ḏa‘ kî- ḡêr yih·yeh zar·‘ă·ḵā bə·’e·reṣ lō lā·hem wa·‘ă·ḇā·ḏūm wə·‘in·nū ’ō·ṯām ’ar·ba‘ mê·’ō·wṯ šā·nāh
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Abram Know for certain . . . that your descendants will be strangers in a land that is not their own and they will be enslaved and mistreated four hundred years
verses.literalPt: E lhe foi dito: Sabe, com certeza, que a tua semente será peregrina em terra alheia, e será reduzida à escravidão, e será aflita por quatrocentos anos.

verses.original: וְגַ֧ם אֶת־ הַגּ֛וֹי אֲשֶׁ֥ר יַעֲבֹ֖דוּ דָּ֣ן אָנֹ֑כִי וְאַחֲרֵי־ כֵ֥ן יֵצְא֖וּ בִּרְכֻ֥שׁ גָּדֽוֹל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḡam ’eṯ- hag·gō·w ’ă·šer ya·‘ă·ḇō·ḏū dān ’ā·nō·ḵî wə·’a·ḥă·rê- ḵên yê·ṣə·’ū bir·ḵuš gā·ḏō·wl
verses.literal: But I will judge the nation they serve as slaves and afterward . . . they will depart with many possessions
verses.literalPt: Sabe, também, que eu hei de julgar a nação a que têm de servir; e, depois, sairão com grandes riquezas.

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֛ה תָּב֥וֹא אֶל־ אֲבֹתֶ֖יךָ בְּשָׁל֑וֹם תִּקָּבֵ֖ר בְּשֵׂיבָ֥ה טוֹבָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tāh tā·ḇō·w ’el- ’ă·ḇō·ṯe·ḵā bə·šā·lō·wm tiq·qā·ḇêr bə·śê·ḇāh ṭō·w·ḇāh
verses.literal: You, however will go to your fathers in peace and be buried at a ripe old age . . .
verses.literalPt: Tu, porém, irás em paz para teus pais; serás sepultado numa boa velhice.

verses.original: וְד֥וֹר רְבִיעִ֖י יָשׁ֣וּבוּ הֵ֑נָּה כִּ֧י לֹא־ שָׁלֵ֛ם עֲוֺ֥ן הָאֱמֹרִ֖י עַד־ הֵֽנָּה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḏō·wr rə·ḇî·‘î yā·šū·ḇū hên·nāh kî lō- šā·lêm ‘ă·wōn hā·’ĕ·mō·rî ‘aḏ- hên·nāh
verses.literal: In the fourth generation your descendants will return here for the iniquity of the Amorites is not yet . . . complete
verses.literalPt: Na quarta geração, voltarão para cá, porque a medida da iniquidade dos amorreus ainda não está cheia.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֤י הַשֶּׁ֙מֶשׁ֙ בָּ֔אָה וַעֲלָטָ֖ה הָיָ֑ה וְהִנֵּ֨ה תַנּ֤וּר עָשָׁן֙ וְלַפִּ֣יד אֵ֔שׁ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָבַ֔ר בֵּ֖ין הַגְּזָרִ֥ים הָאֵֽלֶּה׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî haš·še·meš bā·’āh wa·‘ă·lā·ṭāh hā·yāh wə·hin·nêh ṯan·nūr ‘ā·šān wə·lap·pîḏ ’êš ’ă·šer ‘ā·ḇar bên hag·gə·zā·rîm hā·’êl·leh
verses.literal: When the sun had set and darkness had fallen . . . behold a smoking firepot and a flaming torch appeared and passed between the halves of the carcasses
verses.literalPt: Quando o sol já estava posto, e era escuro, um fogo fumegante e uma tocha de fogo passaram por entre aquelas metades.

verses.original: בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא כָּרַ֧ת יְהוָ֛ה אֶת־ אַבְרָ֖ם בְּרִ֣ית לֵאמֹ֑ר לְזַרְעֲךָ֗ נָתַ֙תִּי֙ אֶת־ הָאָ֣רֶץ הַזֹּ֔את מִנְּהַ֣ר מִצְרַ֔יִם עַד־ הַנָּהָ֥ר הַגָּדֹ֖ל נְהַר־ פְּרָֽת׃
verses.transliteration: bay·yō·wm ha·hū kā·raṯ Yah·weh ’eṯ- ’aḇ·rām bə·rîṯ lê·mōr lə·zar·‘ă·ḵā nā·ṯat·tî ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ haz·zōṯ min·nə·har miṣ·ra·yim ‘aḏ- han·nā·hār hag·gā·ḏōl nə·har- pə·rāṯ
verses.literal: On that day the LORD made a covenant with Abram saying To your descendants I have given this land from the river of Egypt to the great River Euphrates . . .
verses.literalPt: Naquele dia, fez Jeová uma aliança com Abrão, dizendo: À tua semente tenho dado esta terra, desde o rio do Egito até o grande rio, o rio Eufrates:

verses.original: אֶת־ הַקֵּינִי֙ וְאֶת־ הַקְּנִזִּ֔י וְאֵ֖ת הַקַּדְמֹנִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ’eṯ- haq·qê·nî wə·’eṯ- haq·qə·niz·zî wə·’êṯ haq·qaḏ·mō·nî
verses.literal: the land of the Kenites Kenizzites Kadmonites
verses.literalPt: o queneu, o quenezeu, o cadmoneu,

verses.original: וְאֶת־ הַחִתִּ֥י וְאֶת־ הַפְּרִזִּ֖י וְאֶת־ הָרְפָאִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- ha·ḥit·tî wə·’eṯ- hap·pə·riz·zî wə·’eṯ- hā·rə·p̄ā·’îm
verses.literal: Hittites Perizzites Rephaites
verses.literalPt: o heteu, o ferezeu, os refains,

verses.original: וְאֶת־ הָֽאֱמֹרִי֙ וְאֶת־ הַֽכְּנַעֲנִ֔י וְאֶת־ הַגִּרְגָּשִׁ֖י וְאֶת־ הַיְבוּסִֽי׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- hā·’ĕ·mō·rî wə·’eṯ- hak·kə·na·‘ă·nî wə·’eṯ- hag·gir·gā·šî wə·’eṯ- hay·ḇū·sî
verses.literal: Amorites Canaanites Girgashites and Jebusites
verses.literalPt: o amorreu, o cananeu, o girgaseu e o jebuseu.
